guidance: Soul Fysh Act1 boss, 211 HP. Ironclad starts 66/80 HP with 4 Plating, Cloak Clasp, Strike Dummy, upgraded Armaments, two Dismantles, Rampage, Omnislice and Weak Potion. Turn1 BECKON gives two status cards, no attack; open with the Replay1 Strike (currently 9 damage per hit). Afterwards re-read state every action. Build damage on harmless/status turns, use Bash before Dismantle when feasible (each Dismantle attacks twice on Vulnerable), and Headbutt to recur Rampage/Bash/other decisive attacks. Upgraded Armaments upgrades every other hand card and gives 5 block; prefer it early if it yields useful upgrades or prevents damage. Gorget Plating and Cloak Clasp reward preserving some hand cards; do not blindly play low-value cards when retaining them adds effective defense. Save Weak Potion for an actual heavy or multi-hit attack that it mitigates; spend before danger, not at 8 HP. Track status/card clutter and exact enemy intents. Never end turn into native lethal risk; prioritize survival over marginal damage. Claim post-boss rewards if won. Stop at MAP, native terminal, explicit budget, or HP<=35 before spending energy for Astra review.
